digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command - mapping configuration diagnostics
propositions: The doctor command must surface internally-invalid mapping config as error findings via MappingConfigError at load time (non-integer hierarchy, malformed blocks) and resolve time (out-of-vocabulary, unmapped-non-skipped values), without blocking the main scan contract.

The doctor command must degrade gracefully when jira-datacenter extra is absent, credentials unset, settings resolution fails, or probe times out, emitting a single unavailable finding and returning success rather than raising.

Offline checks must run always using stdlib-only provider-neutral resolvers (effective_status_map, effective_type_map, effective_link_map, assert_type_decisions_complete) without importing adapters.jira.

Live-drift checks must diff configured vs observed vocabulary on status, type, and link axes when Jira is reachable, emitting one finding per divergence, while deliberately excluding hierarchy since Data Center does not expose hierarchyLevel.
All-empty projects block stubs must surface as warning findings (not errors) during the per-key enumeration pass.
The probe transport must execute under a doctor-side bounded wall-clock timeout (default 10s) to prevent doctor hangs on slow or unresponsive Jira endpoints.
